steps.title: Sign in to Vercel
steps.instruction: Create or sign in to your Vercel account.

steps.title: Import repository
steps.instruction: Import your Git repository. Connect GitHub or GitLab if prompted.

steps.title: Environment variables
steps.instruction: Project → Settings → Environment Variables. Add every key from .env.example for Production and Preview.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.instruction: Push to your production branch or click Redeploy in the Vercel dashboard.

steps.title: Copy live URL
steps.instruction: Copy the Production or Preview URL from Vercel. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (or your app's public URL env) in .env and Vercel env settings.

steps.title: Custom domain (optional)
steps.instruction: Add a custom domain when you are ready for production traffic.
